retrievalProfile.description: A 90s-inspired urban layout featuring a split-color background, extreme perspective photography, and heavy, condensed sans-serif typography with drop shadows.
triggerTerms: split background with condensed red text

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical split composition where the left third is white and the right two-thirds are a dark slate purple, featuring a central figure in extreme foreshortening and bold, vertically-stacked condensed typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical split between white and dark background fields
Extreme perspective (fisheye effect) on the central subject
High-contrast red and black typography overlapping the color boundary
Stacked text blocks creating a rhythmic vertical flow
coreInvariants: Condensed sans-serif typeface with heavy black drop shadows
Red primary text color for emphasis
Extreme foreshortening in the photographic subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure with a hand reaching toward the viewer in extreme close-up, occupying the right two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold red text on the left side of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left text, moves down the vertical stack, then follows the reaching hand into the depth of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The white vertical bar on the left provides a clean field for the primary text elements.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value white against low-value purple, with high-saturation red text for maximum legibility.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'd' in the secondary line is significantly oversized to match the height of the uppercase 'C' above it.

composition.position: left-aligned, spanning the white and purple boundary

treatment.shadow: hard black drop shadow offset to the bottom-right

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying scales and colors (red and black) to create hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel.
Matches the extreme verticality and tight counters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a vertical split background with a white bar on the left (30%) and dark slate purple on the right (70%). Place a figure in the purple section using a fisheye lens effect, with a hand reaching directly toward the camera lens.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add extra-condensed sans-serif text in red with a heavy black drop shadow. Align the text to the left, ensuring it overlaps the boundary between the white and purple background sections.

verificationChecks: Does the red text have a hard black drop shadow?
Is the background split vertically between white and dark purple?
Is the photographic subject shown in extreme perspective?

adjustableVariables: Width of the white vertical bar
Offset distance of the drop shadow
postGenerationChecks: Check that the red text is legible against both background colors.

recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a vertical color-block split with extreme-perspective photography and heavy, condensed, shadowed display type.
